t: A four-level drone curriculum from block coding to ROS 2 and computer vision.
steps: Find the DroneBlocks curriculum and log in at my.droneblocks.io.
Choose the level that fits your grade.
Try a Ground School simulator mission.
Provide your name, email, and school as the educator.
Decide whether students will save flight plans with an optional email.
Plan DEXI drones only for the hardware levels.
